_doc: R3 P1 — the SCENARIO DEFINITIONS a run executes (fixture intent, the ordered UI / staff steps, the LPs observed). An applicability exclusion is bound to sha256 of its scenario's entry here (contract/applicability.js scenarioSha): changing a scenario invalidates its exclusions. The journey reads its intent and step list from this file and asserts it executed exactly these steps.

pageWallClock.form: 13:00 Honduras time (UTC-6) on the run's own Honduras day — inside the X Pizza form's hard-coded delivery HOURS (12:00–19:45 Sun–Wed, 12:00–20:45 Thu–Sat), so ASAP is offered at any hour the suite runs
